title: Lena and the Harvest
author: Edmund Eastwick
blurb: Felix Marchetti, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
